title.narrative: Upscale Small Hydropower Mini-Grid Development in Zambia to Deliver Renewable Energy for Productive Uses - Feasibility Study Phase

description.narrative: The project#s aim is to conduct feasibility studies of potential small hydropower plants (SHP) in Zambia, in order to increase electrification and economic development in rural areas as well as to deliver renewable energy for productive uses. The project is based on the good experience of a previous project to build a SHP mini-grid at Shiwang#andu in Zambia.
